if SpawnWallManager == nil then
    SpawnWallManager = class({})
end

LinkLuaModifier("modifier_wall", "modifiers/modifier_wall", LUA_MODIFIER_MOTION_NONE)

local function EnsureWallState(pid)
    GameState.wall_state = GameState.wall_state or {}
    if not GameState.wall_state[pid] then
        GameState.wall_state[pid] = {
            recruit_count = 0,
            extra_cols = {},
            extra_counts = {},
            base_positions = {},
            good_base_positions = {},
            extra_wall_entids = {},
        }
    end
    return GameState.wall_state[pid]
end

local function BuildExtraSet(state)
    local set = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(state.extra_cols or {}) do
        set[key] = true
    end
    return set
end

function SpawnWallManager:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if GameState.spawn_points[pid] then
        return GameState.spawn_points[pid]
    end

    local points = {
        good = {},
        bad = {},
        good_keys = {},
        bad_keys = {},
    }

    for i = 1, 7, 1 do
        local good_name = "spawn_point_" .. i
        local bad_name = "monster_spawn_point_" .. i
        local good_point = Entities:FindByName(nil, good_name)
        local bad_point = Entities:FindByName(nil, bad_name)
        if good_point then
            local idx = good_point:GetEntityIndex()
            points.good[idx] = good_point:GetAbsOrigin()
            table.insert(points.good_keys, idx)
        end
        if bad_point then
            local idx = bad_point:GetEntityIndex()
            points.bad[idx] = bad_point:GetAbsOrigin()
            table.insert(points.bad_keys, idx)
        end
    end

    GameState.spawn_points[pid] = points
    return points
end

function SpawnWallManager:EnsureBaseWalls(pid, hero)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points then
        return
    end

    if not GameState.walls[pid] then
        GameState.walls[pid] = {}
    end

    for key, value in pairs(points.bad) do
        local existing = GameState.walls[pid][key]
        local wall = existing and EntIndexToHScript(existing) or nil
        if wall and IsValidEntity(wall) then
            if hero and not hero:IsNull() then
                wall:SetOwner(hero)
            end
        else
            local pos = Vector(value.x, 200, 135)
            wall = CreateUnitByName("npc_dota_wall_dummy", pos, false, hero, hero, DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS)
            if wall then
                wall:SetHullRadius(125)
                wall:AddNoDraw()
                wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
                wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
                wall.transfer_damage = true
                if hero and not hero:IsNull() then
                    wall:SetOwner(hero)
                end
                wall.wall_owner_pid = pid
                GameState.walls[pid][key] = wall:GetEntityIndex()
            end
        end
    end
end

function SpawnWallManager:InitPlayer(pid, hero)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points then
        return
    end

    if not hero or hero:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    self:EnsureBaseWalls(pid, hero)

    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    for key, pos in pairs(points.bad) do
        state.base_positions[key] = Vector(pos.x, 200, 135)
    end
    for key, pos in pairs(points.good) do
        state.good_base_positions[key] = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
    end
end

local function FindIndexByKey(list, key)
    if not list then
        return nil
    end
    for i, value in ipairs(list) do
        if value == key then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function SpawnWallManager:AddExtraGoodSlot(pid, bad_key, count)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points or not points.bad_keys or not points.good_keys then
        return
    end

    local idx = FindIndexByKey(points.bad_keys, bad_key)
    if not idx then
        return
    end

    local good_key = points.good_keys[idx]
    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    local base = state.good_base_positions[good_key]
    if not base then
        return
    end

    local new_slot = "extra_" .. tostring(good_key) .. "_" .. tostring(count)
    if points.good[new_slot] then
        return
    end

    local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y + 250 * count, base.z)
    points.good[new_slot] = pos
    table.insert(points.good_keys, new_slot)

    if Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid] and Shop1Managers[pid].Slots then
        if Shop1Managers[pid].Slots[new_slot] == nil then
            Shop1Managers[pid].Slots[new_slot] = -1
        end
    end
end

function SpawnWallManager:ResolveTargetEntId(pid, spawn_ent_id)
    if not spawn_ent_id then
        return nil
    end

    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points or not points.bad_keys then
        return GameState.walls[pid] and GameState.walls[pid][spawn_ent_id] or nil
    end

    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    local extra_set = BuildExtraSet(state)

    local idx = nil
    for i, key in ipairs(points.bad_keys) do
        if key == spawn_ent_id then
            idx = i
            break
        end
    end

    if not idx then
        return GameState.walls[pid] and GameState.walls[pid][spawn_ent_id] or nil
    end

    if not extra_set[spawn_ent_id] then
        return GameState.walls[pid] and GameState.walls[pid][spawn_ent_id] or nil
    end

    local left_key = nil
    for i = idx - 1, 1, -1 do
        local key = points.bad_keys[i]
        if key and not extra_set[key] then
            left_key = key
            break
        end
    end

    local right_key = nil
    for i = idx + 1, #points.bad_keys do
        local key = points.bad_keys[i]
        if key and not extra_set[key] then
            right_key = key
            break
        end
    end

    local target_key = nil
    if left_key and right_key then
        target_key = (RandomInt(0, 1) == 0) and left_key or right_key
    else
        target_key = left_key or right_key or spawn_ent_id
    end

    return GameState.walls[pid] and GameState.walls[pid][target_key] or nil
end

local function BuildCandidateColumns(state, keys)
    local candidates = {}
    local has_extra = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(state.extra_cols or {}) do
        has_extra[key] = true
    end

    if #state.extra_cols < 2 then
        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
            if not has_extra[key] then
                table.insert(candidates, key)
            end
        end
    else
        for _, key in ipairs(state.extra_cols) do
            table.insert(candidates, key)
        end
    end

    return candidates
end

function SpawnWallManager:AddExtraWall(pid, hero)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points then
        return
    end

    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    state.extra_wall_entids = state.extra_wall_entids or {}
    local keys = points.bad_keys
    if not keys or #keys == 0 then
        return
    end

    local candidates = BuildCandidateColumns(state, keys)
    if #candidates == 0 then
        return
    end

    local key = candidates[RandomInt(1, #candidates)]
    local base = state.base_positions[key]
    if not base then
        return
